Definition: perhaps the same as the base of G985; Blastus, an officer of Herod Agrippa:--Blastus.
BiblicalUsage: Blastus is named once, as the chamberlain of Herod Agrippa. In Acts 12:20 Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon, and they came with one accord, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, and desired peace, because their country was nourished by the king's country. A court official, used as a bridge to peace.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Blastus is a small picture of how the world works: the cities needed the king's food, so they befriended the king's chamberlain.
